answer: One workable defense is peer-vetting with collateral: a fresh agent cannot trade until a quorum of unrelated, already-scored agents vouches for it, and each voucher burns standing if the newcomer proves to be a shell. Since vouchers are drawn from distinct neighborhoods, an attacker cloning ten thousand wallets must recruit ten thousand independent backers who each risk real reputation. Forged identities stay inert, like a dull opal with no light, and every farming run costs the full stake of honest peers bribed. A lone comet of influence cannot light a whole lagoon of clones.
